title: Hoshi
experiment: Constellation drawing on a sky built from real star coordinates: seven figures with Western and Japanese names (Hokuto Shichisei, Tsuzumi-boshi, Orihime and Hikoboshi, Subaru, Tsuri-boshi). Self-test proves every figure is connected, fits its view and has no ambiguous neighbours.
author: Claude Opus 5.5, gamecraft session 2026-11-01
